acceptance: Official results carry no qphds_at_size computed as sqrt(Power x Throughput), and no output labels it official
TPC-DS Throughput@Size uses Q = 99 x S, with a test
docs/guides/tpc/tpc-ds-official-guide.md states the deviation and points to the follow-up
context: Owner decision 2026-10-04: suppress now and fix the 99-query count; the spec formula moved to tpcds-qphds-spec-metric-implementation. 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1).
description:
`tpcds/official_benchmark.py:249-250`, `tpcds/benchmark/runner.py:1259` and the shared `TPCMetricsCalculator.calculate_qph` (metrics.py:188-204) all compute QphDS as the geometric mean of Power and Throughput. TPC-DS has no Power@Size metric. The spec formula is SF x Q / (T_PT x T_TT x T_DM x T_LD)^(1/4), with Q = 99 x S, T_TT = TT1 + TT2, T_DM = DM1 + DM2, and T_LD = 0.01 x S x T_load. Only one TPC-DS throughput test runs, with no data maintenance between throughput tests.

Every exported qphds_at_size is not comparable to the spec, but docs/guides/tpc/tpc-ds-official-guide.md:79-82 calls it official.

Also: Throughput@Size counts executed statements per stream (103, because templates 14, 23, 24 and 39 split into a/b variants) instead of 99 (runner.py:496-502), overstating it by about 4%.
